objective: Six-subline MES contract bridge. Use the authoritative six-subline Docker runtime at /assy-demo (TIPA ASSY, contract tipa-assy-demo-v1) as the VF source for the customer VF→MES demo. Additively project authoritative runtime facts into MES-compatible ProjectedMessages: keep mes.execution_event / mes.quality_result / mes.genealogy_relationship / mes.release compatible and ADD mes.run_status, mes.issue, mes.oee_summary, DOWNTIME_START, DOWNTIME_END, LINE_OUT and (where the runtime has an authoritative entry fact) WIP_ENTERED. Do NOT create a parallel simulation and do NOT rewrite the six-subline topology. Findings: (1) separate conveyor_state from operational_state; operational state supports RUNNING → FAULT → STOPPED → RUNNING and only operational state is projected as mes.run_status; (2) one deterministic AP05_JAM exception emitting EXCEPTION_RAISED and EXCEPTION_RESOLVED under mes.issue with shared correlation context; quality HOLD must NOT become a line fault/downtime; (3) one physical downtime lifecycle DOWNTIME_START → DOWNTIME_END per incident (deterministic 120s) derived from simulation time; (4) LINE_OUT fact distinct from AP11 final QC and RELEASE, disposition GOOD|REJECT derived from authoritative WIP/terminal quality state; (5) mes.oee_summary per subline/run with planned_s/run_s/downtime_s/ideal_cycle_s/actual_count/good_count/reject_count/availability/performance/quality/oee, reconciling planned_s=run_s+downtime_s and actual_count=good_count+reject_count, OEE below 100% with at least one reject or terminal failure; (6) contract/provenance: message_key, payload.idempotency_key==message_key, contract_version=tipa-assy-demo-v1, run_id=ASSY-SLxx:R<n>, explicit subline_id, station_id where applicable, simulation_time_s, deterministic non-null occurred_at, stable source event identity; (7) customer control surface continues on /assy-demo: reset bumps run generation and does not reuse idempotency keys; minimal control reset → healthy production → jam → recover → run-to-terminal; no new customer page; change UI labels so conveyor STOPPED is not misread as production line STOPPED; (8) docker/reproducibility: rebuild docker-compose.assy.yml on the exact candidate/review HEAD, image/runtime records or exposes the exact source SHA, prove /assy-demo endpoints run from that image.
explicit_non_objectives: No rewrite of the six-subline runtime
No deletion of the single-subline demo_assy_mes runner before SA approves the migration
No merge/consolidation of the whole branch history into main
No repository MES modification in this gate
required_deliverables: src/virtual_factory/assembly/assy_mes_bridge.py (additive six-subline MES contract bridge: run_status/issue/oee_summary/downtime/LINE_OUT/WIP_ENTERED + contract provenance)
src/virtual_factory/ui/static/* (label change: operational vs conveyor state)
required_tests: Runtime still has exactly 6 sub-lines with PRE-ASSY/AP01..AP11
All 6 sub-lines have distinct run identity (ASSY-SLxx:R<n>)
Target sub-line runs RUNNING → FAULT → STOPPED → RUNNING
One exception raised/resolved (AP05_JAM) with correlated context
Exactly one confirmed downtime lifecycle (DOWNTIME_START → DOWNTIME_END, 120s)
OEE reconciles (planned=run+downtime; actual=good+reject; A/P/Q recomputable) and is below 100%
Duplicate poll/replay does not create new message keys
Reset creates a new run generation without reusing idempotency keys
Full VF test suite stays green
Focused contract tests validate MES-compatible payload fields
